questions.q: How does ArduPilot fundamentally differ from Betaflight?
options: It does not, apart from the user interface
It knows its position and flies by itself
It is meant for planes only
questions.explain: An autopilot: it knows its position, flies missions, and flies without a pilot. Betaflight is a stabilizer under the sticks.

questions.q: Does ArduPilot have a save command?
options: Yes, the same as in Betaflight
questions.explain: Some parameters require a reboot, but the write happens instantly.
Position modes need a healthy position estimate.

options: What is not ready for arming
questions.explain: Disabling the pre-arm checks (ARMING_SKIPCHK; before 4.7, ARMING_CHECK) just to take off is the road to a crash.

options: A hexacopter in the X layout
questions.explain: 1 is Quad, 2 is Hexa, 3 is Octa, 4 is OctaQuad, 7 is Tri.

questions.q: Why do Lua scripts not work on F405 boards?
options: They are forbidden by the license
questions.explain: Scripting is built only for boards with more than 1 MB of flash; an F405 has 1 MB. An F427 with 2 MB (Pixhawk 1) does run Lua.

questions.q: The counterpart of Betaflight Angle in ArduCopter is:
questions.explain: Stabilize stabilizes the angles and does not hold altitude.
